coverage: San Francisco Bay and Delta areas falling in California State Plane Zone 3
license_note: Public-facing California DWR enterprise GIS service. Preserve provider attribution and source metadata with derived samples; verify terms before redistributing bulk raster data.
horizontal_reference: NAD83(2011), California Coordinate System Zone 3, 2025.00 epoch, US survey feet
notes: Primary high-resolution elevation source for the Lombard road profile.
EarthForge samples the public ImageServer along the source-backed Lombard centerline rather than committing the full raster.
Do not mix NAVD88 LiDAR elevations numerically with DataSF San Francisco Elevation Datum contour values unless an explicit datum transformation is applied.
DataSF five-foot contours remain an independent geometry/profile sanity check.
